direction.thesis: A printed cover opening, one physical product stage, and a quiet editable mix; flavor color stays with its object.

axes.composition: Large wordmark establishes identity; asymmetric type/product peers; rhythm changes at catalog, sensation and builder.
axes.typography: Unbounded owns the wordmark, Manrope owns task copy/controls, Georgia italic is an intentional editorial inflection.
axes.color: Warm paper and dark ink stay stable; high-chroma flavor selection is bounded to the product and its selection.
axes.surfaces: Stable paper/ink reading space; bounded warm raised navigation and a fully composed modal with quieter edge, controlled backdrop and shared type. These surfaces receive the same visual bar as the page.
axes.shape: Flat permanent actions; lightly softened temporary menu/dialog edges; curved product geometry stays with the object.
axes.imagery: Code-native cylinder and exact SVG packaging retain state continuity without generated photography.
axes.motion: Finite word/type/object establishment; product manipulation, flavor continuity, local stage response and restrained scroll movement. Static equivalent remains complete.
axes.responsive: Stack product and action; anchor compact navigation from its owner; constrain confirmation to the viewport and scroll its content under text pressure.

revisit: Product material still reads as a flat mockup
Motion competes with reading or delays operation

components.role: Primary pack action and repeated submit
Persistent physical object and static equivalent
Selected flavor in the full catalog
Responsive overlay and wide section navigation
Custom familiar control glyphs inside their real hosts
Authored result, object summary and continuation in the campaign type/material system

relations.intent: Every repeated task/control label retains the Manrope role; editorial exceptions are bounded to display copy.
Routine task controls retain the flat edge language across the full page.
Open layers retain the task typography of the campaign instead of native/library default fonts.
The custom family fits the real owner; quantity glyphs are 16px, CTA glyphs 18px, with no flex shrink or text-font substitution.
Required content fits the declared horizontal CSS viewport without clipping away primary content.
The page substrate and foreground remain stable behind flavor and overlay changes.
A short navigation surface follows its trigger/content, rather than consuming the whole tablet header.

hypotheses.observation: Unbounded bubbles crossed mobile proposition and CTA in an early render.
hypotheses.cause: The decorative particle owner allowed overflow beyond the product scene.
hypotheses.change: Clip particles at the scene while preserving can overflow and interactive targets.
hypotheses.prediction: The motion remains expressive beside the can without washing across reading copy.
hypotheses.applicability: Decorative particles attached to a product scene
counterexamples: An explicitly authored full-screen atmospheric sequence can intentionally cross those boundaries, with separately proven readability.
hypotheses.reason: Inspect temporal samples and static/reduced equivalents; no claim about measured gaze.

hypotheses.observation: The first rigid lid disappeared or still left a visible gap.
hypotheses.cause: Projection and diameter were not yet coherent with the body.
hypotheses.change: Move the lid into the rigid object.
hypotheses.prediction: The join should become physically coherent.
hypotheses.applicability: Attached parts in transformed product scenes
counterexamples: A flat illustration can intentionally use independently authored layers.
hypotheses.reason: Correct parentage alone did not prove visible contact; camera and local dimensions also needed repair.

hypotheses.observation: The lid and label cylinder had different apparent diameters.
hypotheses.cause: A rotated screen-space AABB was used to construct the cylinder.
hypotheses.change: Use local resolved CSS dimensions and a coherent tilt for all parts.
hypotheses.prediction: The metal rim and body remain connected across native sizes and rotation.
counterexamples: Screen-space bounds remain correct for projected hit testing and placement.
hypotheses.reason: Current local-radius and metal-paint probes plus inspected native details/temporal samples support this bounded repair.

hypotheses.observation: An early Pink capture still displayed Sun Shift.
hypotheses.cause: A smooth scroll had not reached the click target before dispatch.
hypotheses.change: Use immediate hit-tested replay and independent observable postconditions.
hypotheses.prediction: Failed state replay cannot mint current evidence.
hypotheses.applicability: Browser evidence of selected, open, focused and confirmation states
counterexamples: Testing scroll choreography itself requires a controlled temporal sequence rather than removing its motion.
hypotheses.reason: The current receipt records actual selected state; the checker compares it with the independently bound plan.

hypotheses.observation: The focused filled action had an invisible paper-colored outer ring.
hypotheses.cause: currentColor inherited on-button text instead of contrasting with the outside substrate.
hypotheses.change: Use the scoped ink focus role and inspect its native viewport/detail.
hypotheses.prediction: Keyboard focus becomes clear on the external paper.
hypotheses.applicability: Filled controls on a light outside surface
counterexamples: An external dark surface can need a light ring.
hypotheses.reason: Visible focus was checked separately from document.activeElement and button text contrast.

hypotheses.observation: The initial short menu used a broad generic shell and heavy outer frame.
hypotheses.cause: Panel extent and row treatment had not been related to the trigger and content.
hypotheses.change: Bound and place the panel locally; finish shared type, row rhythm, edge, elevation and inner focus.
hypotheses.prediction: The open menu reads as a deliberate navigation layer in the campaign.
hypotheses.applicability: Short anchored navigation and command surfaces
counterexamples: Long searchable choices or a touch task can justify a wider sheet.
hypotheses.reason: Native touch/keyboard contexts inspected; different widths are responsive evidence, not an isolated causal treatment experiment.

hypotheses.observation: Secondary surfaces need the same positive visual bar as the page.
hypotheses.cause: A functional wrapper does not establish hierarchy, material or finish.
hypotheses.change: Compose a result title, aligned objects/quantities, quiet total and one continuation using the page type/material system.
hypotheses.prediction: The dialog becomes a complete, coherent small composition.
hypotheses.applicability: Product confirmation surfaces with meaningful object summaries
counterexamples: A frequent expert editor can need a quieter title and no product imagery.
hypotheses.reason: Open native viewports, body/close/details and text-pressure scroll reviewed; technical PASS was kept separate from this self-review.

hypotheses.observation: A document crop of a top-layer dialog moved after a full-page capture.
hypotheses.cause: Viewport-fixed paint was treated as an ordinary document-space box.
hypotheses.change: Bind a viewport-space crop to the original native frame and physical pixel rectangle.
hypotheses.prediction: The reviewed detail comes from the exact state/viewport seen by the user.
hypotheses.applicability: Fixed, top-layer and portalled detail evidence
counterexamples: Ordinary flow owners are appropriately captured in document coordinates.
hypotheses.reason: Parent digest, coordinates and PNG geometry are checked; enlargement is diagnostic and not a new DPR claim.
